interface.signature: def articulationPoints(V: int, adj: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:

preconditions.description: The number of vertices V is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The adjacency list has exactly V entries, one for each vertex.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= v < V for row in adj for v in row)
preconditions.description: All adjacency list entries are valid vertex indices between 0 and V-1.

preconditions.expression: all(u in adj[v] for v in range(V) for u in adj[v])
preconditions.description: The graph is undirected; if u is in adj[v], then v is in adj[u].

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value is a list of integers.
The returned list is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [-1] if not any(is_articulation(v, V, adj) for v in range(V)) else sorted([v for v in range(V) if is_articulation(v, V, adj)])
postconditions.description: If no articulation points exist, return [-1]; otherwise, return the sorted list of all vertices v such that removing v increases the number of connected components.
